Wanted Poster Maker

Make an old-west WANTED poster with a sepia photo, name, crime and reward — rendered on aged paper.

For fun and personal use only — don't use it to impersonate or defame a real person. Everything runs in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose a photo for the wanted portrait.
  2. Type the outlaw's name, the crime, and the reward amount.
  3. Pick whether they are wanted dead or alive.
  4. Click "Download poster" to save the PNG.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does it get the old-west look?

Sepia toning, vignette edges, paper grain and the classic type layout recreate the look. The photo is converted to sepia automatically.

Can I put a friend's face on it?

Yes — for personal, non-commercial fun. Don't use it to impersonate or defame a real person.

What size is the download?

The poster is rendered at 800 × 1100 px PNG, sharp for sharing and small prints.
